strings: r_c0 listens as m_c explains that it doesn't seem like {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can hear the details of the world anymore.

m_c realizes one day that the noises around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} are no longer just quiet, but functionally silent. It seems {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} lost too much of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hearing.
